Package eu.algites.lib.storage.object

Interface AIiObjectStorage

All Known Subinterfaces:
AIiObjectStorageConditionalDeleter, AIiObjectStorageConditionalUpdater, AIiObjectStorageCreateOnlyWriter, AIiObjectStorageLister, AIiObjectStorageOverwriter, AIiObjectStorageReader, AIiObjectStorageStronglyConsistentBackend
public interface AIiObjectStorage
Identity shared by the independently granted object-storage capabilities. A storage instance represents one configured physical namespace and authorized root/prefix; keys passed to methods are relative to this namespace.

Implementations must be safe for concurrent independent callers. Implementers must not infer security privileges from interface identity: every operation must still be authorized by the actual configured backend credentials.

Identity is stable across actions and retries using the same configured namespace. It contains no credentials and is not an object URI.
